transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm... I'm here because of work. The environmental modeling contract. I'm pretty sure the people on that team are... well, they've been tracking my revisions. Planting errors in the datasets. They want to make it look like I can't lead the work. My wife and the junior analysts keep saying it's just version-control mistakes, but... I know what I'm seeing.
Have you been feeling unusually high or euphoric lately?
No. I don't... I haven't felt like that. I'm not sure why you would ask that, really. I just feel normal. Stressed about the contract, maybe, but... no, not high.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No. I don't... I don't hear anything like that. Just the usual quiet.
Have you found yourself losing interest in things you used to care about?

I suppose. I just... I don't do much right now. I used to go hiking, or out to astronomy nights. Mentoring the younger guys at work. But lately I just... I don't feel much pull to start anything. Or talk to anyone, really. 

I can just sit at my desk for hours. Or out in the garage... the telescope just stays covered up. It's just... how it is.
Have you had the feeling that someone can put thoughts into your mind or take thoughts out of it?
No. I... no. My thoughts are just my own. I haven't had anything like that happen.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day?
No. I don't... I don't feel sad, if that's what you mean. I'm not sitting around crying or anything. It's just... like I said, I just don't do much. But I wouldn't call it depressed.
Have people been telling you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?
No. I haven't... no one has said that to me. Like I said before, I don't really talk to many people right now anyway. But when I do... no, they seem to understand me fine.
Have you had the feeling that other people can know what you’re thinking, even when you haven’t said anything?
No. I... no. My thoughts are private. I don't think anyone knows what I'm thinking.
Do you believe your coworkers are using any special technology or hidden methods to interfere with your work?

...Well, yes. That's... that's actually why I'm here, really. I'm pretty sure the people on this environmental modeling contract are tracking my revisions. They keep... planting errors in the datasets. Just to make it look like I can't lead the work. My wife and the junior analysts, they keep telling me it's just version-control mistakes, but... I know what I'm seeing.
Have other people said that you seem emotionally flat or that your face shows less expression than it used to?

No, they haven't said that. I just... I don't really interact with people much anymore. I can sit for hours at my desk, or out in the garage with the telescope still covered up. I used to like things—hiking, mentoring the younger analysts, going to astronomy nights. But now... I just don't feel much pull to start anything. Or talk to anyone. So I guess they wouldn't really have a chance to notice my face.
How long have you been convinced that your coworkers are tracking your revisions and planting errors in the datasets?
It's been... about two months. That I've known for certain, anyway.
For how long have you been experiencing these problems overall?

Well... it's been a while. The whole... decline, I guess you could call it. It started when they put me in charge of that larger environmental modeling contract. That was... about two years and two months ago, I think.
During this time, have you been feeling hopeless?
No... I wouldn't say hopeless. Just... I don't know. I'm just here.
Have you been having trouble keeping up with your work duties compared with how you used to?

Yeah... I suppose I have. I've fallen pretty far behind on the deliverables for the modeling project. It got bad enough that the firm had to reassign parts of the contract to other people. And... well, I haven't been much help to the junior analysts I'm supposed to be supervising, either. I just... I don't know. 

Even at home, I just keep to myself mostly. My wife has to push me just to... keep up with basic routines, you know? It's just been hard to focus.
Has your face shown less expression than it used to?

I don't know about my face. My wife says I don't... look like I'm really there anymore. I just... I can sit for hours at my desk. Or out in the garage. The telescope is out there, still covered. I used to like that stuff... astronomy nights, hiking, helping the younger guys at work. Now I just... I don't feel much pull to start anything. Or talk to anyone. I just sit.
Before you became convinced your coworkers were sabotaging the project, had you already lost interest and motivation in things you used to enjoy?
I'm not sure. I didn't really... keep track of when exactly things changed. It all just sort of... blends together now. I don't know what happened first.
Before you became convinced your coworkers were sabotaging the project, were you already spending long periods just sitting and doing very little?
I don't know. Like I said... it's all just blurry. I can't really piece together what came first, the sitting around or... or the rest of it. I just don't remember.
Has your wife said that you seem to have less emotion in your voice or face than you used to?

I... I think I just told you what she said. About me not looking like I'm really there. As for my voice... I don't know. I guess I just don't talk much. 

Like I was saying, these days I can just sit for hours. At my desk, or out in the garage with the telescope covered up. I know I used to enjoy things... the hiking, mentoring the younger analysts at work, going to those astronomy nights. But... I just don't feel much pull to talk to anyone now. Or start anything.
Have you been seeing things that other people could not see?
No. I haven't... I don't see things that aren't there. Just what's in front of me.
Have people had trouble following what you say because your thoughts seem jumbled or hard to organize?
I don't... no. I don't think so. Nobody has said that to me. Like I mentioned, I just... I don't really talk enough lately for anyone to have trouble following me.
